summary: A toddler toy firmware with four cards on the PRESETS wheel: nursery songs, spoken letters, counting numbers and a simple piano. There are no menus or settings.
features: SONGS: each of the 27 keys plays a public-domain nursery song
LETTERS shows and speaks A-Z; NUMBERS counts dots aloud
PIANO plays the real pitches and shows the note name
Buttons play drums with a kit per card; 17 sounds on SELECT
OCT- / OCT+ stop everything; remembers card, sound and song speed
Version 0.1; voice clips are for non-commercial family use
